name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LastPass.equality_cube_flip
title: Open: the equality-cube flip of the multi-pass masked GGH15 candidate with the comparator on the last copy (regime (d))
statement: Masked gamma-tensor GGH15 (Def_WE_LastPassGGH15.lastPassView) over h levels holding c >= 2 copies of n witness bits (last copy on the last n levels, laid out by copyOff), for a CNF Psi containing the equality clauses between consecutive copies; the comparator reads only the last copy. If t < 2^n and no string whose last copy is the Gray codeword of rank t satisfies Psi, then under decision LWE with k bits in the CVW18 regime, the hybrids (t, eq labelled mask) and (t, eq labelled mask') are CloseAt with loss (h+1) hopLoss(h, rows) and simulation cost simCost (rows = 3 dR + w n' + n).
